arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS users_with_online_transaction FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Counts the distinct users who have at least one online transaction, using all transactions regardless of fraud label.
assumptions: 'Online transaction' means transaction_type = 'Online Transaction', not transactions at online merchant locations.
Covers the full data period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
All transactions are counted, including those with no fraud label, since the question is about user activity rather than fraud rates.
Users are linked to transactions through cards.user_id.
